labelsProvenance.main: Labels drafted by ChatGPT; reviewed independently by ChatGPT and Claude (agreed on 64 of 68 rows); final decisions approved by Sameer. Not an independent human labelling.

dev.labelsProvenance: Labels drafted by ChatGPT; reviewed independently by ChatGPT and Claude (agreed on 64 of 68 rows); final decisions approved by Sameer. Not an independent human labelling.

note: Counts, character ranges, verdicts, tokens, latency and cost only. No key, prompt, reply, reason or quote is stored; passages can be rebuilt from the ranges and the CVs (contentSha256 identifies the text the ranges index). All four verdict-mode and match-mode combinations are scored from the same extraction.

definitions.hit: A verified passage hits a gold passage of the same requirement in the same CV when their character ranges overlap by at least half of the shorter one ("half", the headline) or by at least one character ("any").
definitions.passageRecall: gold passages hit by at least one verified passage / gold passages
definitions.passagePrecision: verified passages that hit a gold passage / verified passages (a verified passage for a requirement with no gold passage is a miss)
definitions.fabricatedQuoteRate: quotes refused as not found in the CV / quotes proposed in a valid shape (refused-as-too-short and over-a-masked-detail are counted apart)
definitions.verdictAgreement: requirements where the scored verdict equals the labeller's. model_checked: the model's verdict after the code's rules and the second opinion; matcher: the matcher alone judging the same verified passages
definitions.modelProposedAgreement: the model's own verdicts against the labels, before the code lowered any (an unanswered requirement counts as unclear)
definitions.downgradeRate: verdicts the code lowered to unclear because no quoted passage was found in the CV / verdicts the model proposed
definitions.secondOpinion: the matcher's verdict from the same verified passages against the model's enforced verdict: agree, one step apart, two steps or more apart (all shown). The score is lowered pending review only where the model is two steps or more HIGHER and the quoted passages share no word with the requirement; a candidate is routed to a person only when that happens on a must-have
definitions.tierAgreement: CVs where the tier from the scored verdicts equals the tier from the labeller's verdicts, by the application's own rule (before any routing to review)
definitions.goldThroughMatcher: what the matching stage says when the labeller's own gold passages are the evidence: the matcher's disagreement with the labels before any model is involved

prices: Anthropic list prices, US dollars per million tokens, as given by the owner on 2026-10-15
scoringNote: The model_checked verdicts and the agreement, tier and routing numbers in this file were computed with a rule that lowered a credited verdict whose quotes share no word with the requirement to the matcher's verdict. That rule was removed on 2026-10-19. The same replies re-scored without it are in the file named in supersededBy (verdict agreement 86.8%, tier agreement 85.0%, 1 of 20 routed). The model's replies, passages, tokens, latency and cost in this file are unchanged. The matcher-alone numbers are unaffected.
